title: Data Quality Gate
summary: Validate data against explicit quality rules at defined points in a data flow and block, quarantine or flag data that fails, with evidence recorded.

relationships.title: Quality Is Managed at the Source

body_markdown:
# Data Quality Gate

## Problem

Bad data propagates silently to consumers and is discovered late.

## Context

Pipelines between layers, producer interfaces, migrations.

## Forces

- Blocking protects consumers but can halt the business.
- Rule maintenance effort.

## Solution

At each gate, evaluate owned rules (per [[Data Quality Dimension|dimension]]) with a severity: **blocking** (stop/quarantine), **warning** (pass and flag), **info**. Record results as quality metadata and route issues to the owning steward.

## Architecture

```text
Input → rule engine (rules from contract/catalog) → pass → next layer
                                               ↘ fail(blocking) → quarantine + issue
                                               ↘ fail(warning) → pass + flag
```

This repository applies the same pattern to knowledge: VALID / WARNING / BLOCKING ERROR.

## Advantages

- Early detection; measurable quality; evidence for audits.

## Disadvantages

- Rule sprawl; false positives.

## Risks

- Gates that only warn become ignored.

## When to Use

- Any promotion to a trusted layer; migration loads.

## When Not to Use

- Exploratory sandboxes.

## Alternatives

Downstream reconciliation only (weaker).

## Examples

- Blocking rule "policy has exactly one holder"; warning rule "email present".
